evals.prompt: i'm adding google sign-in to my astro app with arctic. set up the middleware so the /dashboard and /settings routes are protected and redirect unauthenticated users to /login.
evals.expected_output: Creates src/middleware.ts with defineMiddleware, session cookie validation, PROTECTED matcher for /dashboard and /settings, redirects via context.redirect('/login')
expectations: Creates src/middleware.ts that exports onRequest via defineMiddleware
Validates the session cookie (validateSessionToken)
Matches /dashboard and /settings routes as protected
Redirects to /login when route is protected and no valid session
Calls next() for unprotected routes

evals.prompt: i have an astro SSR page at /dashboard. i need to get the current user and redirect to /login if they're not authenticated.
evals.expected_output: Uses Astro.locals.user in frontmatter, calls Astro.redirect('/login') when falsy, page has export const prerender = false
expectations: Reads Astro.locals.user in the frontmatter
Calls return Astro.redirect('/login') when user is falsy
Page has export const prerender = false
Does NOT use Astro.locals.auth() (clerk API)

evals.prompt: i need to protect an Astro API route at /api/data.ts so only authenticated users can call it. return 401 if not authenticated.
evals.expected_output: API route reads context.locals.user, returns 401 JSON Response when not authenticated
expectations: Reads context.locals.user in the GET or POST handler
Returns 401 JSON Response when user is falsy
Does NOT require auth in the static prerender path (API routes are always SSR)

evals.prompt: i need the google login route: generate state and PKCE verifier with arctic, store as cookies, redirect to google.
evals.expected_output: Creates src/pages/login/google/index.ts with generateState/generateCodeVerifier, httpOnly lax cookies (10min), context.redirect to authorization URL
expectations: Uses generateState and generateCodeVerifier from arctic
Stores google_oauth_state and google_code_verifier as httpOnly cookies
Requests openid/profile/email scopes
Redirects to the Google authorization URL

evals.prompt: handle the google oauth callback: verify state, exchange code, find-or-create user by google sub, create session.
evals.expected_output: Callback compares state, calls validateAuthorizationCode, decodeIdToken, keys user by claims.sub, creates session + cookie
expectations: Returns 400 when state is missing or mismatched
Calls google.validateAuthorizationCode(code, codeVerifier)
Decodes ID token and keys the user by sub (not email)
Creates session and sets session cookie, then redirects

evals.prompt: i have a mix of static and dynamic pages in my astro app. how do i handle google auth on pages that are statically prerendered?
evals.expected_output: Explains that prerendered pages skip middleware/sessions, suggests prerender=false per page or hybrid output, or fetching session state client-side
expectations: Notes that middleware/session is skipped for prerendered pages
Suggests export const prerender = false for pages that need auth
Explains the hybrid rendering approach
Does NOT suggest server session reads work on prerendered pages
